_comment: Acme demo roadmap for the fixture provider (repos acme/api and acme/web). 25 issues, 2 closed, 23 open. It shows: 7 waves with parallel branches; every body dependency form (Depends on, Blocked by list item, Blocks, task-list requires, '## Depends on' section, cross-repo acme/api#N, URL ref) plus native blockedBy; closed dependencies (satisfied, never block); a dangling reference (acme/api#99); a 3-issue cycle (acme/api#11, #12, #13) with downstream issues (acme/api#14, acme/web#7) that are blocked-by-cycle; prose, code-block, inline-code and blockquote mentions that must NOT count; P0/P1/P2 priority labels, milestones and assignees. See test/fixtures/README.md for the expected results.
